$comment: Read from the SIA chart set AD 2 LFKB (AIP France, chart dated 2026-01-22): the reporting points come from the coordinates table of the chart,
the notes from the English column of its text pages, both read by a script and checked (each point lies within 80 NM of the aerodrome).
Only what the chart prints is recorded; nothing is deduced. Services, frequencies, elevation, position, magnetic variation and runways
were first extracted automatically from the chart text. Drawings (circuit, routes, radials) are not read.
The charts themselves are (c) SIA and are not redistributed. Flight simulation only: never use for real navigation.
name: Bastia Poretta

source.extraction: chart text, table and English column read by script, checked

service.atsHours: H24 - Aérodrome de BASTIA PORETTA 20290 Borgo (UTC HIV ; HOR ETE : -1HR)

reportingPoints.name: HZ
reportingPoints.location: 200 m west of the photovoltaic field

reportingPoints.name: HW
reportingPoints.location: Intersection of the national road and the 2 x 2 lane road

notes: Simultaneous movement on two adjacent parking cones prohibited.
ULM activity: AD authorized for class 2, 3, 4 and 6 ULMs equipped with radio and mode C transponder: may be subject to integrate into aerodrome trafic.
Home based ULM: activity defined by agreement with ATC.
TWY M (21,50 m wide) limited to C code ACFT.
TWY C (12,20 m wide) limited to B code ACFT and prohibited at night.
AD likely to be covered by sea haze in a few minutes.
The relief proximity may force to turn toward the sea and climb before reporting point NW.
Paraglider activity in CTR's vicinity on an NW-W axis and close to S point, strong watch recommended.
Red kite birds presence from spring to early july, average weight 1.1 kg.
Above 1000 ft ASFC or 1500 ft AMSL, request to BASTIA information the clearance to entry within the TMA 1.
Preferred ALT 1000 ft ASFC MAX at N1 and 1500 ft MAX at S.
AD circuit on west of AD, near relief, is possible with clearance, at the same altitude than published circuit seaward (1000 ft).
Use of PAPI 34 is mandatory day and night.
Low height circuit: on ATC clearance for instruction flight, seaward circuit, East of AD only.
Except for "Sécurité Civile" ACFT performing their mission (Trackers, Canadairs) or special ATC clearance, turn around on RWY prohibited for ACFT over 5700 kg.
ENR 3.3.4 - LFMM MEDITERRANEE ITI NIGHT VFR.
Traffic surveillance equipment: AD equipped with secondary surveillance radar (see AD 1.0) and ADS-B.
Aerobatics NR 7001: above AD, 3000 ft / 5000 ft AMSL.
Parachuting NR 405: H24-FL 195.
Activity known by BASTIA APP.

Radiocommunication failure: report 1500 ft over SA, avoid flying over parachuting NR 405, fly overhead airfield mid-RWY to join East side of the airport maintaining 1500 ft to join the circuit to QFU in use, complying with the air traffic and / or the wind sock.
Divers / Miscellaneous: PPR mandatory 48HR for all general aviation and business flights, by E-mail: ppr@satab.aero.
